paper_title: Dark Matter Axion Search Using a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
notes: ADMX sidecar cavity axion search with a Josephson Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier. Excludes axion-photon coupling above ~10^-13 GeV^-1 over 4796.7-4799.5 MHz (m_a ~ 19.84 ueV). Limit values taken from abstract/text; the coupling limit is roughly flat ~1e-13 GeV^-1 across the narrow mass band (masses computed from frequency using m=4.136e-15*f). Assumed local DM density 0.45 GeV/cc. Detailed Fig.7 curve values not tabulated. | selector: text (sole candidate)
